items.title: Govctl – A CLI enforcing RFC-driven discipline on AI coding
items.raw_excerpt: AI coding assistants are fast but undisciplined. They jump from idea to implementation without specification. Docs drift from code. "Best practices" become optional suggestions. I built govctl to fix this. It's an opinionated governance CLI that enforces phase discipline on software development: spec → impl → test → stable Every feature requires an RFC before implementation. Phases can't be skipped. Gates are checked, not suggested. The workflow: $ govctl new rfc "Caching Strategy" # spec first $ govctl finalize RFC-0015 normative # lock the spec $ govctl advance RFC-0015 impl # now you can code $ govctl check # validate everything govctl governs itself. Every feature in the CLI was specified in an RFC/ADR before a line of code was written. This repo is the proof that the model works. Not

title_i18n.zh: Govctl——一款通过命令行界面强制执行基于RFC规范的AI编码纪律工具。
title_i18n.es: Govctl – Una CLI que impone disciplina basada en RFC en la codificación con IA

items.title: UAIP Protocol – Secure settlement layer for autonomous AI agents
items.raw_excerpt:
Hi HN! Creator here.
I built UAIP (Universal Agent Interoperability Protocol) - infrastructure that enables AI agents from different companies (OpenAI, Anthropic, Microsoft) to securely transact with each other.
The Problem:
As AI agents become autonomous economic actors, they need: Cryptographic identity (not just API keys)
Secure payment rails for cross-company transactions
Automated compliance (EU AI Act, SOC2, GDPR)
Forensic audit trails The Solution:
5-layer security stack combining: Zero-Knowledge Proofs (Schnorr/Curve25519) for identity
Multi-chain settlement (USDC on Base, Solana, Ethereum)
RAG-based compliance auditing (Llama-3-Legal)
Ed25519 signatures for non-repudiation
Complete audit logging Technical Stack: Backend: Python, FastAPI, SQLite (WAL mode)
Cryptography: NaCl, custo

items.raw_excerpt: Hi HN, I have been working with regulation-heavy documents lately, and one thing kept bothering me. Flat RAG pipelines often fail to retrieve related articles together, even when they are clearly connected through references, definitions, or clauses. After trying several RAG setups, I subjectively felt that GraphRAG was a better mental model for this kind of data. The Microsoft GraphRAG paper and reference implementation were helpful starting points. However, in practice, I found one recurring friction point: graph storage and vector indexing are usually handled by separate systems, which felt unnecessarily heavy for short-lived analysis tasks. title_i18n.es: Por qué la IA no piensa: debemos dejar de llamarlo "cognición".

items.title: I created an MCP that lets AI debug runtime code (breakpoints, stepping, etc.)
items.raw_excerpt: A developer has created an MCP tool that enables AI to debug runtime code with features like breakpoints and stepping, available as an open-source project on GitHub to enhance AI-assisted programming debugging.

title_i18n.en: I created an MCP that lets AI debug runtime code (breakpoints, stepping, etc.)
title_i18n.zh: 我开发了一个MCP，使AI能够调试运行时代码（断点、单步执行等）。
title_i18n.es: Creé un MCP que permite a la IA depurar código en tiempo de ejecución (puntos de interrupción, ejecución paso a paso, etc.).

excerpt_i18n.en: A developer has created an MCP tool that enables AI to debug runtime code with features like breakpoints and stepping, available as an open-source project on GitHub to enhance AI-assisted programming debugging.
excerpt_i18n.zh: 开发者创建了一个名为MCP的工具，使AI能够调试运行时代码，支持断点、单步执行等功能。该项目已在GitHub开源，旨在提升AI辅助编程的调试效率。

items.title: Breaking the Linearity Barrier: Recursive Swarms for Long-Horizon AI Engineering
items.raw_excerpt: Researchers propose a 'recursive swarm' method to overcome linearity barriers in AI engineering, enabling long-horizon planning through hierarchical recursive structures for complex multi-step tasks.

title_i18n.en: Breaking the Linearity Barrier: Recursive Swarms for Long-Horizon AI Engineering
title_i18n.zh: 打破线性壁垒：递归群集实现长远人工智能工程
title_i18n.es: Rompiendo la Barrera de la Linealidad: Enjambres Recursivos para la Ingeniería de IA de Largo Horizonte

excerpt_i18n.en: Researchers propose a 'recursive swarm' method to overcome linearity barriers in AI engineering, enabling long-horizon planning through hierarchical recursive structures for complex multi-step tasks.
excerpt_i18n.zh: 研究人员提出了一种名为'递归群'的新方法，旨在突破人工智能工程中的线性障碍，实现更长远的目标规划。该方法通过分层递归结构，使AI系统能够处理复杂的多步骤任务，有望提升自主系统的决策能力和适应性。

items.title: Starting from scratch: Training a 30M Topological Transformer
items.raw_excerpt: Tauformer is a topological transformer (see paper ) that replaces dot‑product attention with a Laplacian-derived scalar (taumode) per token/head, then attends using distances in that scalar space. Below is a post-style overview of the idea and the first training signals from a 30M-parameter run.

title_i18n.en: Starting from scratch: Training a 30M Topological Transformer
title_i18n.zh: 从零开始：训练一个3000万参数的拓扑变换器
title_i18n.es: Desde cero: Entrenando un Transformador Topológico de 30 millones

excerpt_i18n.en: Tauformer is a topological transformer (see paper ) that replaces dot‑product attention with a Laplacian-derived scalar (taumode) per token/head, then attends using distances in that scalar space. Below is a post-style overview of the idea and the first training signals from a 30M-parameter run.
excerpt_i18n.zh: Tauformer是一种拓扑变换器（参见论文），它用每个标记/头的拉普拉斯派生标量（taumode）替代点积注意力机制，随后在该标量空间的距离基础上进行注意力计算。以下是一篇帖子风格的概述。
excerpt_i18n.es: Tauformer es un transformador topológico (ver artículo ) que sustituye la atención de producto escalar por un escalar derivado de la Laplaciana (taumodo) por token/cabezal, y luego atiende utilizando distancias en ese espacio escalar.
